content: If you’ve got international travel coming up, an adapter is essential for keeping your phone, earbuds, power banks, and other gadgets charged. Anker’s Nano Travel Adapter is one of our picks from our guide to the best gadgets for summer travel because it can charge up to five devices at once, yet it’s small enough to fit in the palm of your hand. It’s also available in black for just $19.99 ($6 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, and directly from Anker (with code WS7DV2BNB82J) matching its best price to date. [Product: Anker Nano Travel Adapter (5-in-1, 20W) | https://www.amazon.com/Anker-Adapter-Temperature-Compatible-Countries/dp/B0DHVNW1CN/?tag=theverge02-20, https://anker.pxf.io/c/482924/1543964/18023?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.anker.com%2Fproducts%2Fa9215%3Fvariant%3D44790594044054] The Nano’s four built-in sets of prongs should keep you covered in “over 200 countries and regions,” according to Anker. It also features two USB-C ports and two USB-A ports, along with an AC outlet for plugging in a standard wall charger. A single USB-C port delivers up to 20W, which should be enough to get an iPhone 17 to 50 percent in less than 30 minutes. That’s not enough power to charge most laptops, making the USB ports better suited for smaller gadgets like phones, tablets, earbuds, and power banks. You can still charge your laptop, however, by plugging its wall charger into the AC outlet. What’s more, it’s designed to take up as little space as possible. The adapter’s only an inch thick with its prongs folded in and, at 3.8 ounces, weighs less than a smartphone. Just keep in mind that the Nano doesn’t convert voltage, so you’ll want to make sure gadgets like hair dryers and electric razors support the voltage at your destination before plugging them in.
chineseTitle: Anker 的旅行充电器几乎适用于任何国家，价格低至 20 美元
chineseSummary: 如果您即将进行国际旅行，适配器对于为手机、耳机、移动电源和其他小工具充电至关重要。 Anker 的 Nano 旅行适配器是我们从夏季旅行最佳小工具指南中挑选的产品之一，因为它可以同时为最多五台设备充电，但它足够小 [...]
chineseContent: 如果您即将进行国际旅行，适配器对于为手机、耳机、移动电源和其他小工具充电至关重要。 Anker 的 Nano 旅行适配器是我们从夏季旅行最佳小工具指南中挑选出来的产品之一，因为它可以同时为最多五台设备充电，而且它足够小，可以放在手掌中。它还有黑色款，只需 19.99 美元（折扣 6 美元），可在 Amazon、Best Buy 和 Anker 直接购买（使用代码 WS7DV2BNB82J），与迄今为止的最优惠价格相匹配。 [产品：Anker Nano 旅行适配器（5 合 1，20W）| https://www.amazon.com/Anker-Adapter-Temperature-Compatible-Countries/dp/B0DHVNW1CN/?tag=theverge02-20， https://anker.pxf.io/c/482924/1543964/18023?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.anker.com%2Fproducts%2Fa9215%3Fvariant%3D44790594044054] 据介绍，Nano 的四组内置插脚应该可以让您覆盖“200 多个国家和地区”安克。它还具有两个 USB-C 端口和两个 USB-A 端口，以及一个用于插入标准壁式充电器的交流电源插座。单个 USB-C 端口可提供高达 20W 的功率，这足以让 iPhone 17 在 30 分钟内电量达到 50%。这个电量不足以为大多数笔记本电脑充电，因此 USB 端口更适合手机、平板电脑、耳塞和移动电源等小型设备。不过，您仍然可以通过将壁式充电器插入交流电源插座来为笔记本电脑充电。更重要的是，它的设计占用尽可能少的空间。该适配器的插脚折叠后只有 1 英寸厚，重量为 3.8 盎司，比智能手机还轻。请记住，Nano 不会转换电压，因此在插入吹风机和电动剃须刀等小工具之前，您需要确保它们支持目的地的电压。
